title: 第1396章 帝葬第1395章 女帝之威
slug: 无敌凡体以剑证道杀穿三千界
lines: 去坟墓中休息会儿？
李轩的脸色瞬间僵硬。
这特么都是什么虎狼之词？
他并没有动，而是看向了瑶荷女帝。
瑶荷女帝冲着他点头，传音道：“你先去休息吧，放心，有本帝在，他们不敢对你如何。”
瑶荷女帝都这么说了，李轩自然也没有办法反驳。
他没有废话，闪身向着那座坟墓奔了过去。
坟墓中漆黑一片，显得很是阴森，哪怕这是一座大殿，都仍然给了李轩一种毛骨悚然之感。
这里真的是太阴森了，阴风阵阵，无比的阴寒，纵然李轩阳气旺盛，都是只感觉遍体生寒。
还好他的修为已经达到了至仙，且也算是经历过不少生死，所以倒是也没有那么恐惧。
他迅速开始布置阵法，直到各种阵法遍布在整座大殿，这才走到那张冷冰冰的床上坐了下去。
“哎，这叫什么事，帝坟宗帝坟宗，还真是没有愧对这个宗名。”
李轩叹息一声，并未在坟墓中多留，而是直接进入了小鼎空间。
这段时间以来，他连番大战，已经是相当的疲惫。
他要进入小鼎中休息一段时间，然后再消化一下最近所得。
最关键的是，他身上的资源实在太多了，多的根本就没有时间去用，他要再提升一下自己的修为，那样也好应对接下来的事情。
李轩进入坟墓中没有多久，洛依和青婵就出现在了坟墓之外。
洛依看了一眼下方的坟墓，叹道：“真是没有想到，这小子竟然会被瑶荷女帝那般看中，甚至都惊动了老祖。”
她看向青婵：“怎么，你难道不打算进去与他接触一下吗？”
青婵闻言，却是摇了摇头：“算了，先不要进去了，他布置了那么多阵法，显然是不想被打扰。”
说到这里，她有些不满的看了洛依一眼：“你看你搞出来的这些事情，他接下来的日子恐怕不太好过了。”
李轩虽被瑶荷女帝看中，但毕竟是外人，且瑶荷女帝也不可能永远护在其身旁。
他这才刚刚进入帝坟宗，便是将帝坟宗的弟子强者都得罪了个遍，甚至还得罪了一尊仙王境巅峰长老。
可以想象，接下来的日子必然不会平静，那些人势必不会善罢甘休。
洛依闻言，却是不屑的撇了撇嘴：“怕什么？他们没本事，难道还能怪别人？若不怕继续受辱，便尽管去找那小子好了。”
说着，她还冷哼了一声，不满道：“仙王境巅峰，竟然奈何不了区区一个至仙，也真是够丢人的，若传出去，我帝坟宗的面子恐怕都会丢尽。”
青婵无语。
至仙？
开什么玩笑，李轩那也能算是至仙？
她看了一眼洛依，半晌无言。
content_en:
Go and rest in the tomb for a while?
Li Xuan's face instantly stiffened.
What the hell are these words of tiger and wolf?
He did not move, but looked at Empress Yaohe.
Empress Yaohe nodded at him and said through a message: "You should go and rest first. Don't worry, they don't dare to do anything to you as long as I am here."
Empress Yaohe said so, so Li Xuan naturally had no way to refute.
He didn't waste any time and ran towards the tomb.
The tomb was pitch dark and eerie. Even though it was a large hall, it still gave Li Xuan a creepy feeling.
It was really too gloomy here, with gusts of wind and extremely cold air. Even though Li Xuan had strong Yang Qi, he only felt cold all over his body.
Fortunately, his cultivation level has reached the level of immortality, and he has experienced many lives and deaths, so he is not that afraid.
He quickly began to arrange the formations until various formations were spread throughout the hall, then he walked to the cold bed and sat down.
"Hey, what is this? The Emperor's Tomb Sect is truly worthy of its name."
Li Xuan sighed and did not stay in the tomb any longer, but directly entered the small cauldron space.
During this period of time, he had been fighting continuously and was already quite exhausted.
He wants to enter the small cauldron to rest for a while, and then digest what he has recently gained.
The most important thing is that he has so many resources that he has no time to use them. He needs to improve his cultivation level so that he can cope with the next thing.
···
Not long after Li Xuan entered the tomb, Luo Yi and Qingchan appeared outside the tomb.
Luo Yi glanced at the tomb below and sighed: "I really didn't expect that this boy would be so favored by Empress Yaohe, and even alarmed our ancestors."
She looked at Qingchan: "Why, don't you plan to go in and have some contact with him?"
When Qingchan heard this, he shook his head: "Forget it, don't go in yet. He has arranged so many formations, obviously he doesn't want to be disturbed."
Speaking of this, she glanced at Luo Yi with some dissatisfaction: "Look at the things you have done, I'm afraid his life will not be easy in the future."
Although Li Xuan was favored by Empress Yaohe, he was an outsider after all, and Empress Yaohe could not protect him forever.
He had just entered the Emperor's Tomb Sect, and he had already offended all the powerful disciples of the Emperor's Tomb Sect, and even offended an elder at the peak of the Immortal King Realm.
It is conceivable that the days to come will not be peaceful, and those people will not give up.
When Luo Yi heard this, he curled his lips disdainfully: "What are you afraid of? They have no ability, how can they blame others? If you are not afraid of being humiliated, just go find that boy."
As she said this, she snorted coldly and said dissatisfied: "It's really shameful that at the peak of the Immortal King Realm, you can't do anything to a mere Immortal. If word gets out, our Emperor's Tomb Sect will probably lose all face."
Qingchan was speechless.
The ultimate immortal?
Are you kidding me? Li Xuan can be considered an immortal?
She glanced at Luo Yi and was speechless for a while.
